land.text: Albania as Cliopatria's last wartime shape (1945), the land of the Democratic Government of Albania

predecessors.note: The page's 'preceded by' is the Democratic Government of Albania (infobox 'Democratic Government: 20 October 1944'); 'On 29 November 1944, Albania was liberated'. Cliopatria's albania row (eu-18) runs to 1945.

successors.note: 'The Republic of Albania was proclaimed on 29 April 1991'; infobox 'Communist state abolished: 29 April 1991'. Cliopatria's rows share Wikidata Q467864; they are kept as two dossiers (see notes).

rulers.title: First Secretary
rulers.note: 'The state was first led by Enver Hoxha from 1946 to 1985'; 'Hoxha died on 11 April 1985.' The head of state was the Chairman of the Presidium of the People's Assembly: Omer Nishani 1946-1953, Haxhi Lleshi 1953-1982, Ramiz Alia 1982-1991.

rulers.name: Ramiz Alia (First Secretary of the Party of Labour)
rulers.title: First Secretary

keyframe_review.note: 27,769 km2 for 1946-47 against the infobox 28,748 km2 (no year given): ratio 0.97. The shape is the Albanian state within its frontier of 1913-1921 (96 grid cells, the same as every later shape). Sazan Island (5.7 km2) joins in 1947 but is smaller than a grid cell; the ledger carries it.

27,817 km2 for 1948 only: cell for cell the shape of 1946-47 and 1949-89 (the 48 km2 difference is outline noise, not a boundary change). Nothing on the pages moves the frontier in 1948 (the Yugoslav break of 28 June 1948 changes alliances, not land).

27,793 km2 for 1949-89, ratio 0.97 against the infobox. No frontier change on the pages; Kosovo stays in Yugoslavia ('In January 1945, the two governments signed a treaty establishing Kosovo as a Yugoslav autonomous province') and the Greek claim to southern Albania ('Northern Epirus') is only a demand.
27,793 km2 for 1990, unchanged. The communist state is abolished on 29 April 1991, after the Cliopatria row's last year; the Republic of Albania row starts in 1991 with the same cells.

region.text: Albania within its existing frontiers, governed from Tirana

ledger.note: 11 January 1946: the People's Republic of Albania is formed. Infobox: 'People's Republic formed: 11 January 1946'; the Democratic Government of 20 October 1944 and the liberation of 29 November 1944 come first. The frontier is that of the earlier Albanian state; the page gives no territorial change at the founding.

region.text: Sazan Island (Saseno), 5.7 km2, at the mouth of the Bay of Vlorë

ledger.note: 1947: Sazan Island passes to Albania. 'After the war, in 1947, the Paris Peace Treaty transferred sovereignty over the island to Albania'; Italy had held it from 1920 ('Albania formally ceded the island to Italy on 2 September 1920'). The treaty page (signed 10 February 1947, in force 15 September 1947) does not name Sazan, only that Italy recognised Albania's independence. The island is below the size of one grid cell, so the region is drawn as a 15 km circle round Vlore.

28 December 1976: the People's Republic of Albania becomes the People's Socialist Republic. 'Originally founded as the People's Republic of Albania from 1946 to 1976'; infobox 'Constitution amended: 28 December 1976'. Colour and dossier continue.

region.text: the whole of Albania, passing unchanged to the Republic of Albania

ledger.note: 29 April 1991: the communist state is abolished. 'On 11 December 1990 ... Alia announced' political pluralism, 'Alia's party won the elections on 31 March 1991', and 'The Republic of Albania was proclaimed on 29 April 1991'.

certainty.note: Albania's frontiers are the surveyed and treaty lines of 1913-1921, unchanged except for Sazan Island in 1947; nothing on the pages opened makes any frontier soft.

notes:
Cliopatria rows: People's Socialist Republic of Albania 1946..1990 (4 shapes) and Republic of Albania 1991..2024 share Wikidata Q467864 (the Albania article). Treated here as two states: the communist state ends on 29 April 1991 (page infobox) and the Republic of Albania row is owned by another eu-22 part, which would otherwise collide with a merged dossier; the land is cell-for-cell identical (96 cells, 1946 to 1990 and from 1991), so the orchestrator may merge them into one colour family without changing any border. The Cliopatria row's last year is 1990; the state ends on 29 April 1991 (dissolve event).

All four shape verdicts are 'ok': the four outlines are the same 96 grid cells (areas 27,769, 27,817, 27,793 and 27,793 km2 differ only in outline detail) and the infobox area (28,748 km2, no year) is within 3 percent. No frontier changed except Sazan Island (5.7 km2) in 1947, which is smaller than a cell. wars is empty: the pages opened record no war with a territorial result (the Corfu Channel incident of 22 October 1946 was a mine incident with Britain; the Greek-Albanian state of war and the Northern Epirus claim are not dated on the page). The wording 'Saseno' is not on the pages.

Names the gazetteer lacks: Sazan Island (Saseno), 40.5 N 19.3 E, an island of 5.7 km2 off the Karaburun peninsula at the mouth of the Bay of Vlore; it resolves to no grid cell, so a 15 km circle round Vlore stands in. Counterpart: republic-of-italy (the Paris treaty party); the 1946-1990 Yugoslav frontier is not a matter for this dossier.
